parts.text:
{
  "extractions": [
    {
      "unit": "F001",
      "unit_attributes": {
        "kind": "permission",
        "scope_quotes": [
          "F001"
        ],
        "scope_text": "In containers at or near any point of generation where wastes initially accumulate which is under the control of the operator of the process generating the waste, provided that all of the conditions for exemption in this rule are met.",
        "context_quotes": [],
        "modality_quote": "may",
        "modality": "may",
        "alternative_quotes": [
          "F001"
        ],
        "choice_quote": "F001",
        "choice_text": "Either one quart of liquid acute hazardous waste listed in rule 3745-51-31 or paragraph (E) of rule 3745-51-33 of the Administrative Code, or one kilogram (kg) (2.2 pounds) of solid acute hazardous waste listed in rule 3745-51-31 or paragraph (E) of rule 3745-51-33 of the Administrative Code, alongside as much as fifty-five gallons of non-acute hazardous waste.",
        "logic_quote": "F001",
        "references": [
          "rule 3745-51-31",
          "paragraph (E) of rule 3745-51-33",
          "Chapters 3745-50",
          "3745-54 to 3745-57",
          "3745-205",
          "3745-65 to 3745-69",
          "3745-256",
          "3745-266",
          "3745-267",
          "paragraph (B) of rule 3745-52-16",
          "paragraph (A) of rule 3745-52-17",
          "paragraphs (A)(7) and (A)(8) of this rule"
        ],
        "statement": "A generator may accumulate as much as fifty-five gallons of non-acute hazardous waste and either one quart of liquid acute hazardous waste listed in rule 3745-51-31 or paragraph (E) of rule 3745-51-33 of the Administrative Code or one kilogram (kg) (2.2 pounds) of solid acute hazardous waste listed in rule 3745-51-31 or paragraph (E) of rule 3745-51-33 of the Administrative Code in containers at or near any point of generation where wastes initially accumulate which is under the control of the operator of the process generating the waste, without a permit or permit by rule and without complying with Chapters 3745-50, 3745-54 to 3745-57, 3745-205, 3745-65 to 3745-69, 3745-256, 3745-266, and 3745-267 of the Administrative Code, provided that all conditions for exemption in this rule are met."
      }
    },
    {
      "unit": "F001",
      "unit_attributes": {
        "kind": "permission",
        "scope_quotes": [
          "F001"
        ],
        "scope_text": "Except as required in paragraphs (A)(7) and (A)(8) of this rule.",
        "context_quotes": [],
        "modality_quote": "may",
        "modality": "may",
        "alternative_quotes": [
          "F001"
        ],
        "choice_quote": "F001",
        "choice_text": "Paragraph (B) of rule 3745-52-16 or paragraph (A) of rule 3745-52-17 of the Administrative Code.",
        "logic_quote": "F001",
        "references": [
          "paragraph (B) of rule 3745-52-16",
          "paragraph (A) of rule 3745-52-17",
          "paragraphs (A)(7) and (A)(8) of this rule"
        ],
        "statement": "A generator may comply with the conditions for exemption in this rule instead of complying with the conditions for exemption in paragraph (B) of rule 3745-52-16 or paragraph (A) of rule 3745-52-17 of the Administrative Code, except as required in paragraphs (A)(7) and (A)(8) of this rule."
      }
    },
    {
      "unit": "F002",
      "unit_attributes": {
        "kind": "requirement",
        "scope_quotes": [
          "F001",
          "F002"
        ],
        "scope_text": "Under the satellite accumulation exemption conditions, if a container holding hazardous waste is not in good condition, or if the container begins to leak.",
        "context_quotes": [],
        "modality_quote": "shall",
        "modality": "must",
        "alternative_quotes": [
          "F002"
        ],
        "choice_quote": "F002",
        "choice_text": "Immediately transfer the hazardous waste from this container to a container that is in good condition and does not leak, or immediately transfer and manage the waste in a central accumulation area operated in compliance with paragraph (B) of rule 3745-52-16 or paragraph (A) of rule 3745-52-17 of the Administrative Code.",
        "logic_quote": "F002",
        "references": [
          "paragraph (B) of rule 3745-52-16",
          "paragraph (A) of rule 3745-52-17"
        ],
        "statement": "If a container holding hazardous waste is not in good condition, or if the container begins to leak, the generator shall immediately transfer the hazardous waste from this container to a container that is in good condition and does not leak, or immediately transfer and manage the waste in a central accumulation area operated in compliance with paragraph (B) of rule 3745-52-16 or paragraph (A) of rule 3745-52-17 of the Administrative Code."
      }
    },
    {
      "unit": "F003",
      "unit_attributes": {
        "kind": "requirement",
        "scope_quotes": [
          "F001"
        ],
        "scope_text": "Under the conditions for exemption for satellite accumulation.",
        "context_quotes": [],
        "modality_quote": "shall",
        "modality": "must",
        "alternative_quotes": [],
        "choice_quote": "",
        "choice_text": "",
        "logic_quote": "F003",
        "references": [],
        "statement": "The generator shall use a container made of or lined with materials that will not react with, and are otherwise compatible with, the hazardous waste to be accumulated, so that the ability of the container to contain the waste is not impaired."
      }
    },
    {
      "unit": "F005",
      "unit_attributes": {
        "kind": "prohibition",
        "scope_quotes": [
          "F001",
          "F005"
        ],
        "scope_text": "Under satellite accumulation exemption conditions, unless paragraph (B) of rule 3745-65-17 of the Administrative Code is complied with.",
        "context_quotes": [],
        "modality_quote": "shall not",
        "modality": "must_not",
        "alternative_quotes": [
          "F005"
        ],
        "choice_quote": "F005",
        "choice_text": "Incompatible wastes, or incompatible wastes and materials.",
        "logic_quote": "F005",
        "references": [
          "rule 3745-66-99",
          "paragraph (B) of rule 3745-65-17"
        ],
        "statement": "Incompatible wastes, or incompatible wastes and materials (see appendix to rule 3745-66-99 of the Administrative Code for examples), shall not be placed in the same container, unless paragraph (B) of rule 3745-65-17 of the Administrative Code is complied with."
      }
    },
    {
      "unit": "F006",
      "unit_attributes": {
        "kind": "prohibition",
        "scope_quotes": [
          "F001",
          "F006"
        ],
        "scope_text": "Under satellite accumulation exemption conditions, unless paragraph (B) of rule 3745-65-17 of the Administrative Code is complied with.",
        "context_quotes": [],
        "modality_quote": "shall not",
        "modality": "must_not",
        "alternative_quotes": [
          "F006"
        ],
        "choice_quote": "F006",
        "choice_text": "An incompatible waste or material.",
        "logic_quote": "F006",
        "references": [
          "rule 3745-66-99",
          "paragraph (B) of rule 3745-65-17"
        ],
        "statement": "Hazardous waste shall not be placed in an unwashed container that previously held an incompatible waste or material (see appendix to rule 3745-66-99 of the Administrative Code for examples), unless paragraph (B) of rule 3745-65-17 of the Administrative Code is complied with."
      }
    },
    {
      "unit": "F007",
      "unit_attributes": {
        "kind": "requirement",
        "scope_quotes": [
          "F001",
          "F007"
        ],
        "scope_text": "Under satellite accumulation exemption conditions, where a container holds a hazardous waste that is incompatible with any waste or other materials accumulated nearby in other containers.",
        "context_quotes": [],
        "modality_quote": "shall",
        "modality": "must",
        "alternative_quotes": [
          "F007"
        ],
        "choice_quote": "F007",
        "choice_text": "Separated from the other materials or protected from the incompatible waste or material by any practical means.",
        "logic_quote": "F007",
        "references": [],
        "statement": "A container holding a hazardous waste that is incompatible with any waste or other materials accumulated nearby in other containers shall be separated from the other materials or protected from the incompatible waste or material by any practical means."
      }
    },
    {
      "unit": "F008:F012",
      "unit_attributes": {
        "kind": "requirement",
        "scope_quotes": [
          "F001"
        ],
        "scope_text": "During satellite accumulation, except when adding, removing, or consolidating waste; or when temporary venting of a container is necessary for the proper operation of equipment or to prevent dangerous situations, such as build-up of extreme pressure.",
        "context_quotes": [],
        "modality_quote": "shall",
        "modality": "must",
        "alternative_quotes": [
          "F009",
          "F011",
          "F012"
        ],
        "choice_quote": "F008:F012",
        "choice_text": "Except: (a) when adding, removing, or consolidating waste; or (b) when temporary venting of a container is necessary: (i) for the proper operation of equipment; or (ii) to prevent dangerous situations, such as build-up of extreme pressure.",
        "logic_quote": "F008:F012",
        "references": [],
        "statement": "A container holding hazardous waste shall be closed at all times during accumulation, except when adding, removing, or consolidating waste, or when temporary venting of a container is necessary for the proper operation of equipment or to prevent dangerous situations, such as build-up of extreme pressure."
      }
    },
    {
      "unit": "F013:F015",
      "unit_attributes": {
        "kind": "requirement",
        "scope_quotes": [
          "F001"
        ],
        "scope_text": "Under satellite accumulation exemption conditions.",
        "context_quotes": [],
        "modality_quote": "shall",
        "modality": "must",
        "alternative_quotes": [
          "F014",
          "F015"
        ],
        "choice_quote": "F013:F015",
        "choice_text": "Both: (a) The words \"Hazardous Waste\"; and (b) An indication of the hazards of the contents.",
        "logic_quote": "F013:F015",
        "references": [
          "49 CFR Part 172 subpart E",
          "49 CFR Part 172 subpart F",
          "29 CFR 1910.1200"
        ],
        "statement": "A generator shall mark or label the generator's container with both the words \"Hazardous Waste\" and an indication of the hazards of the contents."
      }
    },
    {
      "unit": "F016:F021",
      "unit_attributes": {
        "kind": "requirement",
        "scope_quotes": [
          "F001",
          "F016"
        ],
        "scope_text": "When a generator accumulates either acute hazardous waste listed in rule 3745-51-31 or paragraph (E) of rule 3745-51-33 of the Administrative Code or non-acute hazardous waste in excess of the amounts listed in paragraph (A) of this rule at or near any point of generation.",
        "context_quotes": [],
        "modality_quote": "shall",
        "modality": "must",
        "alternative_quotes": [
          "F017",
          "F019",
          "F020",
          "F021"
        ],
        "choice_quote": "F017:F021",
        "choice_text": "Either: (a) Within three consecutive calendar days, comply with the applicable central accumulation area requirements in paragraph (B) of rule 3745-52-16 or paragraph (A) of rule 3745-52-17 of the Administrative Code; or (b) Remove the excess from the satellite accumulation area within three consecutive calendar days to either: (i) a central accumulation area operated in accordance with the applicable requirements in paragraph (B) of rule 3745-52-16 or paragraph (A) of rule 3745-52-17 of the Administrative Code; (ii) an on-site permit by rule or permitted treatment, storage, or disposal facility; or (iii) an off-site designated facility.",
        "logic_quote": "F017:F021",
        "references": [
          "rule 3745-51-31",
          "paragraph (E) of rule 3745-51-33",
          "paragraph (A) of this rule",
          "paragraph (B) of rule 3745-52-16",
          "paragraph (A) of rule 3745-52-17"
        ],
        "statement": "A generator who accumulates either acute hazardous waste listed in rule 3745-51-31 or paragraph (E) of rule 3745-51-33 of the Administrative Code or non-acute hazardous waste in excess of the amounts listed in paragraph (A) of this rule at or near any point of generation shall do either of the following within three consecutive calendar days: comply with the applicable central accumulation area requirements in paragraph (B) of rule 3745-52-16 or paragraph (A) of rule 3745-52-17 of the Administrative Code; or remove the excess from the satellite accumulation area to either a complying central accumulation area, an on-site permit by rule or permitted treatment, storage, or disposal facility, or an off-site designated facility."
      }
    },
    {
      "unit": "F022",
      "unit_attributes": {
        "kind": "requirement",
        "scope_quotes": [
          "F016",
          "F022"
        ],
        "scope_text": "When a generator accumulates acute hazardous waste or non-acute hazardous waste in excess of the satellite accumulation limits, during the three-consecutive-calendar-day period.",
        "context_quotes": [],
        "modality_quote": "shall",
        "modality": "must",
        "alternative_quotes": [],
        "choice_quote": "",
        "choice_text": "",
        "logic_quote": "F022",
        "references": [
          "paragraphs (A)(1) to (A)(5) of this rule"
        ],
        "statement": "During the three-consecutive-calendar-day period of excess accumulation, the generator shall continue to comply with paragraphs (A)(1) to (A)(5) of this rule, and shall mark or label the containers holding the excess accumulation of hazardous waste with the date the excess amount began accumulating."
      }
    },
    {
      "unit": "F023",
      "unit_attributes": {
        "kind": "requirement",
        "scope_quotes": [
          "F023"
        ],
        "scope_text": "For all satellite accumulation areas operated by a small quantity generator.",
        "context_quotes": [],
        "modality_quote": "shall",
        "modality": "must",
        "alternative_quotes": [],
        "choice_quote": "",
        "choice_text": "",
        "logic_quote": "F023",
        "references": [
          "paragraph (B)(8) of rule 3745-52-16",
          "paragraph (B)(9) of rule 3745-52-16"
        ],
        "statement": "All satellite accumulation areas operated by a small quantity generator shall meet the preparedness and prevention requirements of paragraph (B)(8) of rule 3745-52-16 of the Administrative Code and emergency procedures of paragraph (B)(9) of rule 3745-52-16 of the Administrative Code."
      }
    },
    {
      "unit": "F024",
      "unit_attributes": {
        "kind": "requirement",
        "scope_quotes": [
          "F024"
        ],
        "scope_text": "For all satellite accumulation areas operated by a large quantity generator.",
        "context_quotes": [],
        "modality_quote": "shall",
        "modality": "must",
        "alternative_quotes": [],
        "choice_quote": "",
        "choice_text": "",
        "logic_quote": "F024",
        "references": [
          "rules 3745-52-250 to 3745-52-265"
        ],
        "statement": "All satellite accumulation areas operated by a large quantity generator shall meet the preparedness, prevention, and emergency procedures in rules 3745-52-250 to 3745-52-265 of the Administrative Code."
      }
    },
    {
      "unit": "F026",
      "unit_attributes": {
        "kind": "statement",
        "scope_quotes": [],
        "scope_text": "",
        "context_quotes": [],
        "modality_quote": "",
        "modality": "not_stated",
        "alternative_quotes": [],
        "choice_quote": "",
        "choice_text": "",
        "logic_quote": "",
        "references": [
          "rule 3745-50-11"
        ],
        "statement": "For dates of non-regulatory government publications, publications of recognized organizations and associations, federal rules, and federal statutory provisions referenced in this rule, see rule 3745-50-11 of the Administrative Code titled \"Incorporated by reference.\""
      }
    }
  ]
}

unit_attributes.scope_text: In containers at or near any point of generation where wastes initially accumulate which is under the control of the operator of the process generating the waste, provided that all of the conditions for exemption in this rule are met.
unit_attributes.choice_text: Either one quart of liquid acute hazardous waste listed in rule 3745-51-31 or paragraph (E) of rule 3745-51-33 of the Administrative Code, or one kilogram (kg) (2.2 pounds) of solid acute hazardous waste listed in rule 3745-51-31 or paragraph (E) of rule 3745-51-33 of the Administrative Code, alongside as much as fifty-five gallons of non-acute hazardous waste.
unit_attributes.statement: A generator may accumulate as much as fifty-five gallons of non-acute hazardous waste and either one quart of liquid acute hazardous waste listed in rule 3745-51-31 or paragraph (E) of rule 3745-51-33 of the Administrative Code or one kilogram (kg) (2.2 pounds) of solid acute hazardous waste listed in rule 3745-51-31 or paragraph (E) of rule 3745-51-33 of the Administrative Code in containers at or near any point of generation where wastes initially accumulate which is under the control of the operator of the process generating the waste, without a permit or permit by rule and without complying with Chapters 3745-50, 3745-54 to 3745-57, 3745-205, 3745-65 to 3745-69, 3745-256, 3745-266, and 3745-267 of the Administrative Code, provided that all conditions for exemption in this rule are met.

unit_attributes.scope_text: Except as required in paragraphs (A)(7) and (A)(8) of this rule.
unit_attributes.choice_text: Paragraph (B) of rule 3745-52-16 or paragraph (A) of rule 3745-52-17 of the Administrative Code.
unit_attributes.statement: A generator may comply with the conditions for exemption in this rule instead of complying with the conditions for exemption in paragraph (B) of rule 3745-52-16 or paragraph (A) of rule 3745-52-17 of the Administrative Code, except as required in paragraphs (A)(7) and (A)(8) of this rule.

unit_attributes.scope_text: Under the satellite accumulation exemption conditions, if a container holding hazardous waste is not in good condition, or if the container begins to leak.
unit_attributes.choice_text: Immediately transfer the hazardous waste from this container to a container that is in good condition and does not leak, or immediately transfer and manage the waste in a central accumulation area operated in compliance with paragraph (B) of rule 3745-52-16 or paragraph (A) of rule 3745-52-17 of the Administrative Code.
unit_attributes.statement: If a container holding hazardous waste is not in good condition, or if the container begins to leak, the generator shall immediately transfer the hazardous waste from this container to a container that is in good condition and does not leak, or immediately transfer and manage the waste in a central accumulation area operated in compliance with paragraph (B) of rule 3745-52-16 or paragraph (A) of rule 3745-52-17 of the Administrative Code.

unit_attributes.scope_text: Under the conditions for exemption for satellite accumulation.
unit_attributes.statement: The generator shall use a container made of or lined with materials that will not react with, and are otherwise compatible with, the hazardous waste to be accumulated, so that the ability of the container to contain the waste is not impaired.

unit_attributes.scope_text: Under satellite accumulation exemption conditions, unless paragraph (B) of rule 3745-65-17 of the Administrative Code is complied with.
unit_attributes.choice_text: Incompatible wastes, or incompatible wastes and materials.
unit_attributes.statement: Incompatible wastes, or incompatible wastes and materials (see appendix to rule 3745-66-99 of the Administrative Code for examples), shall not be placed in the same container, unless paragraph (B) of rule 3745-65-17 of the Administrative Code is complied with.

unit_attributes.scope_text: Under satellite accumulation exemption conditions, unless paragraph (B) of rule 3745-65-17 of the Administrative Code is complied with.
unit_attributes.statement: Hazardous waste shall not be placed in an unwashed container that previously held an incompatible waste or material (see appendix to rule 3745-66-99 of the Administrative Code for examples), unless paragraph (B) of rule 3745-65-17 of the Administrative Code is complied with.

unit_attributes.scope_text: Under satellite accumulation exemption conditions, where a container holds a hazardous waste that is incompatible with any waste or other materials accumulated nearby in other containers.
unit_attributes.choice_text: Separated from the other materials or protected from the incompatible waste or material by any practical means.
unit_attributes.statement: A container holding a hazardous waste that is incompatible with any waste or other materials accumulated nearby in other containers shall be separated from the other materials or protected from the incompatible waste or material by any practical means.

unit_attributes.scope_text: During satellite accumulation, except when adding, removing, or consolidating waste; or when temporary venting of a container is necessary for the proper operation of equipment or to prevent dangerous situations, such as build-up of extreme pressure.
unit_attributes.choice_text: Except: (a) when adding, removing, or consolidating waste; or (b) when temporary venting of a container is necessary: (i) for the proper operation of equipment; or (ii) to prevent dangerous situations, such as build-up of extreme pressure.
unit_attributes.statement: A container holding hazardous waste shall be closed at all times during accumulation, except when adding, removing, or consolidating waste, or when temporary venting of a container is necessary for the proper operation of equipment or to prevent dangerous situations, such as build-up of extreme pressure.

unit_attributes.choice_text: Both: (a) The words "Hazardous Waste"; and (b) An indication of the hazards of the contents.
unit_attributes.statement: A generator shall mark or label the generator's container with both the words "Hazardous Waste" and an indication of the hazards of the contents.

unit_attributes.scope_text: When a generator accumulates either acute hazardous waste listed in rule 3745-51-31 or paragraph (E) of rule 3745-51-33 of the Administrative Code or non-acute hazardous waste in excess of the amounts listed in paragraph (A) of this rule at or near any point of generation.
unit_attributes.choice_text: Either: (a) Within three consecutive calendar days, comply with the applicable central accumulation area requirements in paragraph (B) of rule 3745-52-16 or paragraph (A) of rule 3745-52-17 of the Administrative Code; or (b) Remove the excess from the satellite accumulation area within three consecutive calendar days to either: (i) a central accumulation area operated in accordance with the applicable requirements in paragraph (B) of rule 3745-52-16 or paragraph (A) of rule 3745-52-17 of the Administrative Code; (ii) an on-site permit by rule or permitted treatment, storage, or disposal facility; or (iii) an off-site designated facility.
unit_attributes.statement: A generator who accumulates either acute hazardous waste listed in rule 3745-51-31 or paragraph (E) of rule 3745-51-33 of the Administrative Code or non-acute hazardous waste in excess of the amounts listed in paragraph (A) of this rule at or near any point of generation shall do either of the following within three consecutive calendar days: comply with the applicable central accumulation area requirements in paragraph (B) of rule 3745-52-16 or paragraph (A) of rule 3745-52-17 of the Administrative Code; or remove the excess from the satellite accumulation area to either a complying central accumulation area, an on-site permit by rule or permitted treatment, storage, or disposal facility, or an off-site designated facility.

unit_attributes.scope_text: When a generator accumulates acute hazardous waste or non-acute hazardous waste in excess of the satellite accumulation limits, during the three-consecutive-calendar-day period.
unit_attributes.statement: During the three-consecutive-calendar-day period of excess accumulation, the generator shall continue to comply with paragraphs (A)(1) to (A)(5) of this rule, and shall mark or label the containers holding the excess accumulation of hazardous waste with the date the excess amount began accumulating.

unit_attributes.scope_text: For all satellite accumulation areas operated by a small quantity generator.
unit_attributes.statement: All satellite accumulation areas operated by a small quantity generator shall meet the preparedness and prevention requirements of paragraph (B)(8) of rule 3745-52-16 of the Administrative Code and emergency procedures of paragraph (B)(9) of rule 3745-52-16 of the Administrative Code.

unit_attributes.scope_text: For all satellite accumulation areas operated by a large quantity generator.
unit_attributes.statement: All satellite accumulation areas operated by a large quantity generator shall meet the preparedness, prevention, and emergency procedures in rules 3745-52-250 to 3745-52-265 of the Administrative Code.

For dates of non-regulatory government publications, publications of recognized organizations and associations, federal rules, and federal statutory provisions referenced in this rule, see rule 3745-50-11 of the Administrative Code titled "Incorporated by reference."
